Title: Peer feedback with a chatbot in secondary-school argumentative writing: a quasi-experimental study
Abstract: Two hundred grade-10 students received feedback on argumentative essays either from a generative AI chatbot or from peers. Writing quality and self-efficacy were measured before and after an eight-week intervention.
Author Keywords: generative AI; feedback; writing; secondary education

Title: Teachers' perceptions of large language models for lesson planning
Abstract: A survey of 412 primary-school teachers explored attitudes towards using large language models to prepare lessons, including perceived usefulness, trust and workload.
Author Keywords: teachers; lesson planning; large language models

Title: A review of artificial intelligence in higher education assessment
Abstract: This narrative review summarises 120 publications on automated scoring, plagiarism detection and AI-supported feedback in universities.

Title: Transformer models for protein structure prediction
Abstract: We benchmark transformer architectures on protein folding tasks and report improvements in accuracy on standard datasets.

Title: Generative AI tutoring and mathematics achievement in grade 7: a randomised controlled trial
Abstract: Classes were randomly assigned to an AI tutor or business-as-usual instruction for one semester. Achievement was measured with a standardised mathematics test.

Title: Energy consumption of data centres running large language models
Abstract: The study estimates electricity use and carbon emissions of inference workloads in three commercial data centres.
